ns0:problem.ns0:para: Write the inequality shown by the graph with the boundary line y=−x+2.

ns0:media.alt: This figure has the graph of a straight line on the x y-coordinate plane. The x and y axes run from negative 10 to 10. A line is drawn through the points (0, 2), (1, 1), and (2, 0). The line divides the x y-coordinate plane into two halves. The line and the bottom left half are shaded red to indicate that this is where the solutions of the inequality are.
